signals.note: R-S5 + R-Y2 (§Phase 9 §9.1 + §Phase 8): `type_name: boot_fsm_state_e` triggers auto-widening from the SV typedef in soc_ifc_pkg.sv — emits the 5 named variants (BOOT_IDLE..BOOT_DONE) plus 3 synthetic `UNMATCHED_5/6/7` variants for the encodings the type's 3-bit width admits but the case statement doesn't enumerate. Per-signal anyconst init makes the bug-bearing encodings reachable from initialisation. Auto-reproduces the manual Path 1 widening without sidecar editing.

properties.description: Baseline smoke test: every reachable state has at least one outgoing transition.

CWE-1245 safety: the boot FSM's next-state register must never carry an unmatched encoding (5/6/7 are admissible by the 3-bit type but not enumerated in the default-less unique casez). R-S5 (§Phase 9 §9.1) auto-extracts the 8 encodings from the boot_fsm_state_e typedef in soc_ifc_pkg.sv; the unmatched encodings get the synthetic `UNMATCHED_<n>` variant name. Predicate naming follows the `<signal>_<variant>` convention (cwe1245_fsm_bug.mununu.json precedent), so the predicates are `boot_fsm_ns_UNMATCHED_5` etc (note the triple underscore from `boot_fsm_ns` + `_` separator + `UNMATCHED_5`).
Liveness: BOOT_IDLE (named variant from the typedef) is reachable from any state via some path. R-S5 emits the typedef variant names directly so `boot_fsm_ns_BOOT_IDLE` is the predicate.
